evidence.note: The hold-delay callback writes interval set, timeout undefined, and runOnce false together; start writes the inverse timer pair (timeout set, interval undefined) at line 97.
interval is only stored with runOnce false; stop resets to emptySpinnerState (runOnce true, both timers undefined). Both-timers and idle-without-runOnce are never constructed.

notes: Hold-repeat machine idle|first-delay|restart-delay|repeating flattened into runOnce plus mutually exclusive timer payloads.

notes: Boolean times ScribeStatus idle|connecting|connected is six; legal is the three status values. Distinct from SpeechInputContextValue isConnected/isConnecting.
